items.tradition: Small seal script, as represented in a modern SVG redraw
items.caption: Modern redraw of 花 in the seal-script style associated with Shuowen; the graph’s component analysis should not be projected onto earlier 𠌶 or 華 forms.
items.alt: Black seal-style strokes representing 花 on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: Commons identifies the graph and script style and records the source image lineage and reuse terms. It is a relevant, reusable candidate for showing the later graph form, while clearly not an artifact photograph.
items.rights: Public domain release of the SVG representation, as stated on its Commons file page.

limitations.text: This is a modern drawn reconstruction in a historical script style, not a photograph or facsimile of a dated inscription. The page says the specific source image is S04460 from the 華 entry, so the image alone does not prove the exact graphic chronology of 花.
